content.rendered: All students in grades 6-8 will receive a Chromebook for their use at school and home during the 2018-19 school year.  A Chromebook is a web-based laptop computer that is used primarily when connected to the Internet. Students will need to submit a signed Chromebook Checkout Agreement, signed by a parent/guardian, during checkout in the Media Center to receive their device.  Chromebook checkout will occur September 10th -12th.
